The Feathers Fly Part II#002.src: It's time for me to show the Growth Accelerator to the Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.dst: Hora de mostrar o Acelerador de Crescimento aos Corkians.

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.src: Look, this time I'll really try and reward you well, alright?

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#005.src: The Corkians have a council where they deal with their issues. We can try getting an audience.

The Feathers Fly Part II#006.src: I know a way for me to get in the city. That's where you come in! There are some sentries to take care of.

The Feathers Fly Part II#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#010.src: Well then, first off, take this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.dst: Bom, antes de tudo, pega isso!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#011.src: Now, just stand still... I gotta try something on you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.dst: Agora, fica parado... Preciso testar uma coisa em você...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#012.src: Locate and jam all the robot sentries near the Corkus Clocktower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] within {~} seconds
The Feathers Fly Part II#012.dst: Encontre e bloqueie todos os sentinelas robôs perto da torre do relógio de Corkus em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] em até {~} segundos

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.src: Thanks! These robots were harmless but hey, better safe than sorry right?

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#015.src: Anyway, we need to get ready to meet the Corkian Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.dst: Enfim, temos que nos preparar pra ver o Conselho Corkian.

The Feathers Fly Part II#016.src: And I think... I need a disguise. I don't like hiding myself, but I don't have a choice.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.dst: E acho que... preciso de um disfarce. Não gosto de me esconder, mas não tenho escolha.

The Feathers Fly Part II#017.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#020.src: Just look around, and come back with what you think looks better!

The Feathers Fly Part II#114.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#115.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.dst: Ah, com liceeença, alguém mandou você vir aqui? Vai me "impressionar"?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#116.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#117.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.dst: Volte quando tiver algo realmente interessante. Adeus.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#118.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.dst: Hã? Você achou o vendedor e mais um jeito de conseguir audiência?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#119.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.dst: [{~} blocos de esmeralda], é? Não sei se é muito. Acho melhor tentar o outro jeito! Qual é?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#120.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.dst: Tem uma recepcionista para audiências? Que prático! Vamos falar com ela, então!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#121.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Oh... Well, that's not helpful. Maybe we can still give it a go?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.dst: Parece que é... bem difícil? Ah... Bom, isso não ajuda. Será que dá pra tentar mesmo assim?
The Feathers Fly Part II#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#122.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.dst: Compre daquele vendedor esquisito se quiser, mas também devemos ver a recepcionista. Me avise se quiser que eu vá junto.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#123.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.dst: Certo, vamos lá. Acho melhor evitar o vendedor, não quero problema nenhum com a lei!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#124.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.dst: Então o vendedor está aí dentro, é? Vamos seguir em frente. E evitar esse lugar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#125.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.dst: Espera espera espera, o que eu acabei de fal- Vou me encolher aqui...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#126.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.dst: Ei, é [{~} blocos de esmeralda] ou nada! Relaxa, consigo uma audiência pros dois! Sua moça é bem tímida, hein! Acredite, entendo seu drama!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#130.src: And just WHO are you two, busting here like that?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.dst: E QUEM são vocês dois, entrando assim?
The Feathers Fly Part II#130.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#131.src: Uh... Greetings... We've heard that we should come here for-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.dst: Hã... Saudações... Disseram que devíamos vir aqui para-
The Feathers Fly Part II#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#132.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? Shouldn't you be working at that time?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.dst: Têm ALGO pra mostrar? Não deviam estar trabalhando agora?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#132.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#133.src: No, it's just that I, well... Nevermind, I do have a thing to show, it's, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.dst: Não, é que eu, bom... Deixa pra lá, eu tenho algo pra mostrar, é, hã...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#134.src: Not ANOTHER word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.dst: Nem MAIS uma palavra! Já chega! Vocês dois não têm nada que valha meu tempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#134.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.src: Go back to your minimum wage job or something, but stay OUT of my room.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.dst: Voltem pro emprego de salário mínimo, mas FORA da minha sala.
The Feathers Fly Part II#135.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#136.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.dst: O povo disse que era difícil, né? Nem me fale. Devíamos ter algo em mãos antes de entrar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#137.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.dst: Olha, vamos achar outro jeito. Não pode acabar aqui! Precisamos de uma carta-convite pra audiência.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#138.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.dst: Vou voltar pro centro da cidade, se quiser conversar te vejo lá!
The Feathers Fly Part II#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#139.src: That certainly didn't go well. But keep your head up! We got this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.dst: Isso não foi nada bem. Mas cabeça erguida! A gente consegue!
The Feathers Fly Part II#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#140.src: There was a normal way to get an audience which is via a competition. We... missed it. So that'll have to pass.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.dst: Tinha um jeito normal de conseguir audiência: uma competição. A gente... perdeu. Então esquece.
The Feathers Fly Part II#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#141.src: Now, for other... Unconventional ways... There was some panic by the Armour Merchant earlier today.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.dst: E outros jeitos... nada convencionais... Teve alvoroço perto do mercador de armaduras hoje.
The Feathers Fly Part II#141.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#142.src: Check it out if you want, I won't cause trouble. I'd rather be the friendly neighbourhood mechanic!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.dst: Vá ver se quiser, eu não vou arrumar confusão. Prefiro ser a mecânica gente boa do bairro!
The Feathers Fly Part II#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#143.src: There is apparently a dealer in the castle the receptionist's in, first entrance to the left. However, he charges emeralds...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.dst: Parece que tem um vendedor no castelo da recepcionista, primeira entrada à esquerda. Mas ele cobra esmeraldas...
The Feathers Fly Part II#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#144.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.dst: Com certeza achamos uma alternativa de graça. Conto com você! Me avise se quiser que eu vá junto!
The Feathers Fly Part II#144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#145.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.dst: Tomara que a gente acerte. Você guia, eu sigo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#145.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#146.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.dst: Ai, por favor, nem me fale a palavra "audiência"!
The Feathers Fly Part II#146.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#147.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.dst: R-roubaram meu convite agora mesmo! Não acredito!
The Feathers Fly Part II#147.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#148.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.dst: Perguntei por aí, claro que ninguém sabe nada! Estou tentando achar...
The Feathers Fly Part II#148.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#149.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item, wouldn't you think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.dst: Esta pousada está em reforma faz tempo... Ótimo lugar pra esconder algo roubado, não acha?
The Feathers Fly Part II#149.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#150.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.dst: Mas nããão, claro que está trancada! Mas parece que dá pra entrar pelos fundos...
The Feathers Fly Part II#150.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#151.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.dst: Parece que tem um beco suspeito ali... Talvez...
The Feathers Fly Part II#151.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#152.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.dst: Ai, desculpa reclamar tanto. Nem te conheço. Com certeza tem uma passagem ali...
The Feathers Fly Part II#152.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#153.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.dst: Espera espera espera, você achou uma pista, mas prefiro não fazer nada suspeito na cidade. Faça como quiser, vou ficar pelo centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#161.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're on to something but I'd rather not to anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around in the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.dst: Espera espera espera, você achou uma pista, mas prefiro não fazer nada suspeito na cidade. Faça como quiser, vou ficar no centro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#161.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#162.src: Let's hope we don't get rejected this time around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.dst: Tomara que não nos rejeitem desta vez.
The Feathers Fly Part II#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#164.src: Oh god, not another duo. What do you want?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.dst: Ai, Deus, outra dupla não. O que querem?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#164.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#165.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.dst: Ah, hã, saudações! Temos algo pra senhora!
The Feathers Fly Part II#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#166.src: And what would a mechanic have for- Wait, is that an invitation letter..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.dst: E o que uma mecânica teria pa- Espera, isso é uma carta-convite..?
The Feathers Fly Part II#166.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#167.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.dst: Isso é... inédito. Vou ver quando o Conselho está livre e marcar uma audiência...
The Feathers Fly Part II#167.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#168.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.dst: Vocês dois têm muita sorte. Mal posso acreditar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#168.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.dst: Espero que amanhã de manhã sirva, porque o Conselho, por milagre, está livre nesse horário.
The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: Pode ser? Espero que sim, porque vocês não têm muita escolha. Bom, já podem ir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.dst: Nem acredito que estamos avançando de verdade! Que emoção!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: Certo, precisamos testar a máquina antes da audiência. Fiz uns ajustes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.src: Let's meet up near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just meet me by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: Vamos nos encontrar perto da entrada norte se quiser carona. Ou, se curte andar, me encontre direto na Oficina!
The Feathers Fly Part II#173.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!
The Feathers Fly Part II#176.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: É difícil conseguir audiência? Bom, vale a tentativa, né? Talvez me vejam como uma ricaça!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.dst: Ora, olá! Saudações! Bem-vindos! Você está esplêndida, querida!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: Hã?! O-obrigada... É a primeira vez que alguém me diz isso!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: Que bobagem, querida, você é linda! Diga, você quer ser investidora, acertei?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.dst: ...Isso me garante uma audiência com o Conselho?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.dst: Mas é claro! Aquela outra pessoa é seu assistente? Ótimo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: Mostre que tem o que é preciso pra ser uma grande investidora, sim!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.dst: É só me dar meras [{~} esmeraldas líquidas] e está resolvido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.dst: Eu- Vamos... ver o que fazer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: Olha, não sou boa em ser humana, mas até eu sei que isso é uma fortuna absurda!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: Acha que ela aceitaria mesmo? Não sei. Talvez a gente tenha que achar outro jeito...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: Vou voltar pro centro da cidade. Você decide se quer arriscar todo esse dinheiro, se é que você tem! A gente pensa em outra coisa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: Ah, voltaram! E com o dinheiro! Que surpresa! Gostei de vocês!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: O quê? Claro que não vou pegar o dinheiro! Só queria saber se você tinha o que é preciso!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: Agora sei que não é um golpe. Deixa eu ver quando o Conselho está livre...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.dst: Obrigada! Vou tentar não te decepcionar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.dst: Vocês dois têm sorte! Temos um horário livre!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: Espero que amanhã de manhã sirva! Até lá, então!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: Que loucura! [{~} esmeraldas líquidas]? O mundo funciona assim?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: É que... sinceramente, já nem ligo mais pra lei.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: Vamos conseguir essa audiência. Tem uma garota desesperada perto do mercador de armaduras! Será que ela ajuda?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: Quanto a outro jeito, não sei se você reparou no caminho até a recepcionista, mas...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: Parece que tem um vendedor ali dentro. Ele também cobra. Mas com certeza não tanto quanto aquela... maldita... mulher! ...Desculpa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: Oh! Ora, olá, vocês dois! Em que posso ajudar?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: Está esplêndida, querida! Então, veio-- Espere, você tem uma carta?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: Sabe, moça, você teria sido uma grande investidora. Enfim, boa sorte!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: Se quer uma dica, bom... Tem um novato no Conselho, talvez seja mais fácil de impressionar!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#346.src: It's... Apparently really hard? Huh. Well, we should still give it a go? I look fancy, surely they'll listen!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.dst: Parece que é... bem difícil? Hum. Bom, tentamos mesmo assim? Estou chique, com certeza vão me ouvir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#346.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#357.src: Do you have ANYTHING to show? I need more than fancy clothes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.dst: Têm ALGO pra mostrar? Preciso de mais que roupa chique.
The Feathers Fly Part II#357.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#358.src: Oh, uh, we, well I actually made a, uh, what's it called, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.dst: Ah, hã, nós, bom, na verdade eu fiz um, hã, como chama, hã...
The Feathers Fly Part II#358.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#359.src: Not Another word! I've heard enough! You two clearly don't have anything worth my time!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.dst: Nem MAIS uma palavra! Já chega! Vocês dois não têm nada que valha meu tempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#359.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#360.src: And what's up with your face, lady? I'd look into that if I were you! OUT!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.dst: E o que houve com a sua cara, moça? Eu daria uma olhada nisso! FORA!
The Feathers Fly Part II#360.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#367.src: Maybe that's our ticket? I don't know, I'm just a law-abiding citizen. Well, actually, about that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.dst: Será que é nossa chance? Sei lá, sou só uma cidadã honesta. Bom, na verdade, sobre isso...
The Feathers Fly Part II#367.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#379.src: Leaving town? I'll stick around, just come back eventually, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.dst: Vai sair da cidade? Eu fico por aqui, só volte depois, tá?
The Feathers Fly Part II#379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#391.src: Why sure darling, you have {~} seconds to- Hold on, that letter...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.dst: Claro, querida, você tem {~} segundos pra- Espera, essa carta...
The Feathers Fly Part II#391.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#393.src: You two are extremely luck. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.dst: Vocês dois têm muita sorte. Mal posso acreditar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#393.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#395.src: Don't miss it. Oh, and miss, there's something really off about your face.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.dst: Não faltem. Ah, e moça, tem algo muito estranho na sua cara.
The Feathers Fly Part II#395.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#396.src: Thank you so much! Sorry about my face, I'm... New in town. Bye!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.dst: Muito obrigada! Desculpa a cara, sou... nova na cidade. Tchau!
The Feathers Fly Part II#396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#400.src: Urgh, what now? You better be quick.
The Feathers Fly Part II#400.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#401.src: Wait you... You actually have an invitation letter? ...How...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.dst: Espera, você... Tem mesmo uma carta-convite? ...Como...
The Feathers Fly Part II#401.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#402.src: Wait, WHY do you have TWO letters?? This doesn't make any sense?! Oh well, whatever I'm not paid enough to care.

The Feathers Fly Part II#806.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#807.src: And you, you're fiddling not only with nature, but also with OUR things.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.dst: E você não mexe só com a natureza, mas também com as NOSSAS coisas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#808.src: Somehow, you're able to control electromagic? I guess it's not exclusive to humans, then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.dst: De algum jeito você controla eletromagia? Então ela não é exclusiva dos humanos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#809.src: Even then, I see no reason as to why we should let you interact with us. You shouldn't be here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.dst: Mesmo assim, não vejo motivo pra deixarmos você conviver conosco. Você não devia estar aqui.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#810.src: I think... I finally get it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#810.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#811.src: I do, really. The truth is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#811.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#814.src: I come up to you with an incredible breakthrough, and you can't even see past my feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.dst: Venho com uma descoberta incrível e vocês não enxergam além das minhas penas.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#815.src: Alright, I've heard enough. That's it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.dst: Certo, já ouvi o bastante. Chega.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#817.src: Don't you dare touch- Gah! I'll show you. I'll show everyone what you're missing out on!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.dst: Nem ouse tocar- Agh! Vou mostrar. Vou mostrar a todos o que vocês estão perdendo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#818.src: What just... Everyone! Dismissed! What is that girl doing?! I'll go after her! Nodise, Maxie, you go and help Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.dst: O que foi... Pessoal! Sessão encerrada! O que essa garota vai fazer?! Vou atrás dela! Nodise, Maxie, ajudem a Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#823.src: You're crying?! Aw... There, there. It's alright, you made it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.dst: Está chorando?! Ah... Calma, calma. Tudo bem, você conseguiu.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#902.src: God, I hate to say it, but her mask was flawless.
The Feathers Fly Part II#902.dst: Odeio dizer, mas o disfarce dela era impecável.
The Feathers Fly Part II#902.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#903.src: Flawless?! More like flawful! This was so obvious!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.dst: Impecável?! Pecável, isso sim! Era óbvio demais!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#904.src: And WHY didn't you say so??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.dst: E POR QUE você não disse nada??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#905.src: I- uh, y'know, didn't want to assume...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.dst: Eu- hã, sabe, não quis presumir...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#906.src: Urgh. Look, there's only one think I want to know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.dst: Argh. Olha, só tem uma coisa que eu quero saber.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#907.src: ... Did you know, or did she trick you? Be very careful about what you're about to say.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.dst: ... Você sabia, ou ela te enganou? Cuidado com o que vai dizer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#932.src: I didn't really doubt you with your armour. We have a few questions though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.dst: Com essa armadura eu nem duvidei de você. Mas temos algumas perguntas!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#979.src: Huh, that armour's actually powerful. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll show everyone what I'm really capable of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.dst: Hum, essa armadura é poderosa mesmo. Agora, com licença, vou mostrar a todos do que sou capaz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#982.src: Well... Mo'in, {u}. I was thinking about catching up with you and all after the audience, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.dst: Bom... Mo'in, {u}. Pensei em colocar o papo em dia depois da audiência, mas...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#983.src: I guess we don't really have time for that now, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.dst: Acho que agora não temos tempo pra isso, né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#984.src: Wow, Maxie, great time management you got there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.dst: Nossa, Maxie, que ótima gestão de tempo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#985.src: Sybil... This is no time to quarrel.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.dst: Sybil... Não é hora de brigar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#986.src: Have you seen what just happened? I'm sure even now he'll keep defending the Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.dst: Viu o que acabou de acontecer? Aposto que até agora ele vai defender os Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#987.src: Look, there's no time right now. I think {u} and I should go and help.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.dst: Olha, não temos tempo agora. Acho que {u} e eu devíamos ir ajudar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#988.src: Nodise... You probably should stay here too. We-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.dst: Nodise... Talvez você também deva ficar aqui. Nós-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#989.src: Wha-What's happening?! Oh dear, I'll just run there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.dst: O-o que houve?! Minha nossa, vou correndo pra lá!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#990.src: Prevent Ava from making a mistake at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#990.dst: Impeça Ava de cometer um erro em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#991.src: Well look who decided to show up. I thought you would've fled by now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.dst: Ora, veja quem resolveu aparecer. Achei que já teria fugido.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.src: So what? Here to fix your mistakes? Help your insane bird friend?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.dst: E aí? Veio consertar seus erros? Ajudar sua amiga pássaro maluca?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#993.src: For such a plant to grow in a few seconds... I can't believe this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.dst: Uma planta dessas crescer em segundos... Não acredito.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#994.src: Maxie's your friend, right? Well he's in there already. You should go, too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.dst: Maxie é seu amigo, né? Ele já está lá dentro. Você também devia ir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#995.src: I think you gotta reach the top to take care of this. Maybe multiple times.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.dst: Acho que tem que chegar ao topo pra resolver isso. Talvez várias vezes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#998.src: {u}!! I'm sure Efena told you already, no time to talk!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.dst: {u}!! A Efena já deve ter falado, sem tempo pra papo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#999.src: Apparently, there's something up there! Try to reach the top! There are strange plants around, see if that helps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.dst: Parece que tem algo lá em cima! Tente chegar ao topo! Tem umas plantas estranhas por aí, veja se ajudam!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.src: ...You're here. Here to fix my own mistakes, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.dst: ...Você veio. Veio consertar meus erros, né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.src: And then, here to take me, I suppose. Right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.dst: E depois me levar, imagino. Né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.src: Y'know, I noticed you always were one to follow orders. Well, what you're lookin' for is on top of the plant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.dst: Sabe, sempre achei que você era de seguir ordens. Bom, o que procura está no alto da planta.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.src: I... I'm not gonna fight back. There's no point. Just... Just go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.dst: Eu... Não vou resistir. Não adianta. Só... Só vai.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.src: Woah! You did something! You should try that again!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.dst: Uau! Você fez alguma coisa! Tente de novo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.src: I - I really didn't want this... I wanted to help people, {u}! Not... Not...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.dst: Eu - eu não queria isso. Queria ajudar as pessoas, {u}! Não... não...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.src: I sure have impressed everyone. So I guess not all's lost, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.dst: Bom, impressionei todo mundo. Então nem tudo está perdido, né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.src: I'll be the talk of an entire nation!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.dst: Vou ser o assunto de uma nação inteira!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.src: Gosh, I really am going crazy aren't I?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.dst: Nossa, eu estou ficando louca mesmo, né?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.src: I just... I don't know what to do... I reached rock bottom...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.dst: Eu só... Não sei o que fazer... Cheguei ao fundo do poço...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.src: I screwed up with my people, then with the humans, then...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.dst: Estraguei tudo com meu povo, depois com os humanos, depois...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1012.dst: {u}! A Ava está lá em cima, né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1012.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.src: Could you tell her something for me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.dst: Pode dizer uma coisa a ela por mim?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.src: Tell her that... I'm not that mad.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.dst: Diga que... não estou tão brava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.src: This... While destructive, it's impressive, and...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.dst: Isso... Mesmo destrutivo, é impressionante, e...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.src: Whatever, just tell her! People will think I lost my mind, it's fine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.dst: Tanto faz, só diga a ela! Vão achar que enlouqueci, tudo bem!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.src: I'd like to talk to her. I assume she'll just flee, but... You should try!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.dst: Queria falar com ela. Acho que ela vai fugir, mas... Tente!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.src: ...What? Do you have anythin' to tell me before I leave?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.dst: ...O quê? Tem algo pra me dizer antes de eu ir?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.src: Huh?! The president herself isn't too mad at me? What??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.dst: Hã?! A própria presidente não está tão brava comigo? O quê??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.src: Are you trying to make me get down and get arrested? You know I... I can't believe you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.dst: Quer que eu desça pra ser presa? Você sabe que eu... Não acredito que você...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.src: I want to, but... Have you seen how she was during the audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.dst: Eu quero, mas... Viu como ela estava na audiência?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.src: I can't trust you, {u}. There's no way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.dst: Não dá pra confiar em você, {u}. Nunca.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.src: I regret this... I shouldn't have acted this way, this wasn't supposed to happen, I...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.dst: Eu me arrependo... Não devia ter agido assim, isso não devia acontecer, eu...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.src: I can't stay, {u}. The president's one thing, but the others... It's safe to say no one's gonna welcome me with open arms, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.dst: Não posso ficar, {u}. A presidente é uma coisa, mas o resto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.src: No point fighting back, even though I could totally manage. I feel bad for that other girl now. Go, then... Stop my machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.dst: Não adianta resistir, mesmo que eu desse conta. Agora tenho pena daquela outra garota. Vai, então... Pare minha máquina.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.src: Hmpf. Did {u} take that thing down?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.src: Oh she better be around here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.dst: Ah, é bom ela estar por aqui!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.src: Wait, under the rubble, I see something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.dst: Espera, vejo algo sob os escombros!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.src: Look, I'll give you a mission. Find Ava with {u}, and tell her this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.dst: Olha, vou te dar uma missão. Ache a Ava com {u} e diga a ela isto...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.src: Mo'in, {u}! You're fine! I'm so glad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.dst: Mo'in, {u}! Você está bem! Que alívio!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.src: You're something of a hero, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.dst: Você é meio que um herói, sabia?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.src: That was some really nice job back there! But now...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.dst: Que belo trabalho aquele! Mas agora...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.src: Well, the town's fine, but... I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.dst: Bom, a cidade está bem, mas... Me mandaram achar a Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.src: From what I've gathered, you worked with her and know where to go, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.dst: Pelo que sei, você trabalhou com ela e sabe pra onde ir, né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.src: Oh, you told Ava about Efena? And she... she fled. Right. Well, I'm not surprised!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.dst: Você contou à Ava sobre a Efena? E ela... fugiu. Certo. Bom, não me surpreende!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.src: Trust me, we want to help that poor Avo. Let's just find her, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.dst: Acredite, queremos ajudar aquela pobre Avo. Vamos só achar ela, tá?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.src: Tell me whenever you're ready, and we'll go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.dst: Me avise quando estiver pronto, e a gente vai.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.src: Find Ava at the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.dst: O líder Avos falou dela uma vez, mas este lugar é loucura!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.dst: Vocês... Imagino que vieram me levar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.dst: Vão em frente, então. Façam. Não tenho mais nada a perder. Já perdi tudo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.dst: Não quero sua pena. Não tenho ninguém. Você só está dificultando pra si mesmo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.dst: A presidente não te condenou à morte nem nada... Muito pelo contrário.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.dst: Como assim? Por que eu confiaria em você?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.dst: Lugar bacana. Dá pra ver como nossa cultura te influenciou.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.dst: Você veio. Você está... me perdoando?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.dst: Ah, "perdoar" é uma palavra forte demais, Ava. Olha.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.dst: Acho que todos podemos aprender algo com isso. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.dst: Você infringiu a lei, então não pode entrar na cidade. Entendeu?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.dst: Primeiro os Avos, agora vocês, hein. Fechou o ciclo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.dst: Olha, essa sua máquina é impressionante. Sério. Você tem talento.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.dst: Mas com certeza cometeu um baita erro. Eu também.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.src: I guess you and I really learnt what "acting in the heat of the moment" means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.dst: Acho que nós duas aprendemos o que é "agir no calor do momento", né.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.dst: Tenho uma espécie de... acordo. Pra nós duas. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.dst: É, eu... quero trabalhar com você. Aprender com você.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.dst: Você é bem melhor em eletromagia que eu, então...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.dst: Posso te dar o que precisar. Te dar uma mão de vez em quando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.dst: Você ficou sozinha tanto tempo, Ava. Te empresto o Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.dst: *risos* Brincadeira. O resto do Conselho ainda não sabe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.dst: Eles não vão gostar, mas eu cuido disso.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.dst: Sabe que não posso te matar. Imagina como os Avos reagiriam? Mesmo você sendo banida...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.dst: Mas também não quero. Quanto a você, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.dst: Vou te dar umas coisas. Nem imagino como isso teria acabado sem você.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.dst: Agora você está banida de todos, Ava. Sei que não é um final feliz.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.dst: Mas aí seria fácil demais, não acha?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.dst: Talvez mais tarde você tenha seu final feliz. Mas dá pra se contentar em não estar só, né?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Adeus, Ava. Quem sabe, talvez eu apareça de vez em quando.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...{u}? If you stop by the Workshop later, I'll set up something for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...{u}? Se passar na Oficina depois, vou preparar algo pra você também.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes. After all, you're very stylish!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.dst: Adeus, Ava. Quem sabe eu apareça de vez em quando. Afinal, você tem muito estilo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Adeus, Ava. Quem sabe eu apareça às vezes. Talvez até lá você tenha entendido essa sua armadura.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Contate Cerid para mais informações sobre este modelo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Se tiver dúvidas, saiba que eu não sou a máquina certa para perguntar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Ei, tudo bem. Vamos ficar bem.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Sabe, essa sua Oficina é bem melhor do que eu esperava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, obrigado pela ajuda. Você me apresentou um baita talento!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Acredite, sei como é a rejeição. Acho que todo mundo sabe, do seu jeito.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Ela é mais legal que o líder, isso é certo...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Tudo isso é... difícil de acreditar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, quando voltar aqui, vai poder levar alguns dos meus aparelhos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1289.src: You already got an outfit from this drawer.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1290.src: It has random clothes, but no real outfit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1290.dst: Tem roupas avulsas, mas nenhum traje de verdade.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1293.src: You already picked up these clothes. Better find a way to wash them.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1296.src: You find a book about the history of Pirate Cove...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1297.src: You pet the dog. It's a good dog.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1298.src: You pet the dog again. It's still a good dog.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1299.src: You pet the dog again. Very enjoyable, yes.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1300.src: The dog has been pet again.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1302.src: The petting brakes broke. The dog is overjoyed.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1303.src: The dog, has been once again, pet.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1305.src: ...But apparently stopping isn't exactly an option.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1306.src: Or is it? Does free will exist? Or are we forced to forever pet a dog?

The Feathers Fly Part II#1307.src: It looks like there's only one unpleasant way to find out. And it's to stop petting the dog.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1308.src: Though, that's unlikely to happen. He's so cute!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1309.src: It looks like he'll be fine for a while now.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1310.src: But a few more pets won't hurt!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1312.src: The dog is content with your love. That should be enough.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1313.src: You might be able to wash the dirty clothes you found in there!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1317.src: You already picked up this bone.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1319.src: It's empty. You already found this chest.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1319.dst: Está vazio. Você já encontrou este baú.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1323.src: I'll try talking to more people!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1323.dst: Vou tentar falar com mais gente!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1323.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1327.src: Do you think it'd work with that Mechanic outfit? Well, I don't think that matters anymore!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1327.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1329.src: Don't worry, we got this, let's keep looking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1329.dst: Relaxa, a gente dá conta, vamos continuar procurando!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1329.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1333.src: And you booked an audience for tomorrow morning??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1333.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1348.src: It's all over. My life's over...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1348.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.src: We don't have that much time you know!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.dst: A gente não tem tanto tempo assim, viu!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.src: Looks like there's an outfit ready right here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.dst: Parece que tem uma roupa prontinha aqui!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.src: You can give it to Ava, or you can look around the other rooms for more options.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.dst: Você pode dar pra Ava ou procurar mais opções nas outras salas.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.src: There's some clothes here. They're dirty though.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.dst: Tem umas roupas aqui. Mas estão sujas.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.src: There must be a way to wash those somewhere nearby.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.dst: Deve ter algum lugar aqui perto pra lavar isso.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1364.dst: Você começa a lavar as roupas...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.src: Shoot, I think someone's coming!! Come back!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.dst: Droga, acho que vem alguém!! Volta!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.src: You take a look inside the drawer...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.dst: Você dá uma olhada na gaveta...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.src: Lucky! There's a Mechanic Outfit in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.dst: Sorte! Tem um traje de mecânico aí.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.src: You pick up a particularly tasty-looking bone.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.dst: Você pega um osso com cara de muito gostoso.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.src: There's some sort of armour in that chest. It looks flashy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.dst: Tem uma espécie de armadura naquele baú. Parece chamativa!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.src: It's... Quite hard to move around with that outfit, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.dst: É... bem difícil se mexer com essa roupa, na verdade.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.src: ...Is that someone crying over there? Eh, I'm not sure my social skills can handle that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.dst: ...Aquilo ali é alguém chorando? Hã, não sei se minhas habilidades sociais dão conta.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.src: Woah there, what's that letter? You actually got an invitation?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.dst: Opa, que carta é essa? Você conseguiu mesmo um convite?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.src: I... Wow. Well I'm impressed! I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.src: Did we even need a letter? That armour probably would've done the trick!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.dst: A gente precisava de carta? Essa armadura provavelmente teria resolvido!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.src: Well... If you want me to follow you, tell me. I've heard 'bout a receptionist in the far end of the castle, so maybe we should go there?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.dst: Bom... Se quiser que eu te siga, me avise. Ouvi falar de uma recepcionista no fundo do castelo, então talvez a gente deva ir lá?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.src: I heard there was a dealer around here but... We have the letter, so let's just keep goin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.dst: Ouvi dizer que tinha um vendedor por aqui, mas... Temos a carta, então vamos seguindo.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.src: Well, no matter! I'll just... See when the council's available and book a meeting...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.dst: Bom, não importa! Vou só... ver quando o Conselho está livre e marcar uma reunião...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.src: How peculiar. I wonder how they got that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.dst: Que curioso. Como será que conseguiu isso...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.src: Hey! I saw you run towards the castle. What did you do?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.dst: Ei! Te vi correndo pro castelo. O que você fez?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.src: ...Wait, what? You went to the receptionist alone, just like that?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.dst: ...Espera, o quê? Você foi sozinho à recepcionista, assim do nada?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.src: An audience is booked, and you didn't even give me the chance to show my cool armour!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.dst: A audiência está marcada e você nem me deu chance de mostrar minha armadura irada!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.src: I... I'm really grateful. What a relief. I did some tweaking regarding the machine, so you should come and test with me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.dst: Eu... Sou muito grata. Que alívio. Fiz uns ajustes na máquina, então venha testar comigo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.src: As I've said, this is only practice, don't worry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.dst: Como eu disse, isso é só um treino, relaxa.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.src: Just tell me when you're up for another round!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.dst: É só me avisar quando quiser outra rodada!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.src: You probably should wait for Ava first.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.dst: Talvez seja melhor esperar a Ava primeiro.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.src: My guts are telling me this one's gonna be impressive. I hope he's there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.dst: Meu instinto diz que vai ser impressionante. Espero que ele esteja lá.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.src: Looks like she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.dst: Parece que ela espera o seu sinal.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.dst: Até eu estou entrando no clima!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1404.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.src: I still can't believe this isn't about your armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.dst: Ainda não acredito que isso não é sobre a sua armadura.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.src: No worries... Well, I'm worrying, but that doesn't mean you have to.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.dst: Relaxa... Bom, eu estou preocupada, mas você não precisa ficar.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.src: Alright guys, don't worry... We got this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.dst: Certo, pessoal, relaxem... Está sob controle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.src: I'll just... wait for your signal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.dst: Eu só vou... esperar o seu sinal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.src: Hmpf. I certainly am curious now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.src: She's glancing at you. Maybe she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.dst: Ela está te olhando. Talvez espere o seu sinal.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.src: EVERYONE! STOP! {u}, I want you to come here and answer something, immediately.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.dst: TODOS! PAREM! {u}, quero que venha aqui e responda uma coisa, agora.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.src: You take a deep breath, and-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.src: Looks like Maxie wants to speak to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.dst: Parece que o Maxie quer falar com você.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.src: You're- *cough* so good at handling... priorities, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.dst: Você é- *cof* tão bom em lidar com... prioridades, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.src: Save your energy for later, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.dst: Guarde suas forças pra depois, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.src: Even after... Even after this, I'm sure *cough* he'll keep defending them...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.dst: Mesmo depois... Mesmo depois disso, aposto *cof* que vai defendê-los...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.src: You've been... *cough* tricked by... Quite the individual, {u}. You better redeem yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.dst: Você foi... *cof* enganado por... uma figura e tanto, {u}. É bom se redimir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.src: Efena doesn't seem very pleased to see you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.dst: Efena não parece nada feliz em te ver.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.src: No time to talk, {u}! Just go! There must be a core to hit at the top!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.dst: Sem tempo pra papo, {u}! Vai! Deve ter um núcleo pra acertar no topo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.src: Well, besides the citizens being afraid... I'd say the town's fine. However! I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.dst: Bom, tirando os cidadãos com medo... Diria que a cidade está bem. Porém! Me mandaram achar a Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.src: Somehow... Efena ended up liking her.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.dst: Sei lá como... a Efena gostou dela.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.src: I'm reading, but I'll be done soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.src: Y-you!! I- oh no... I'm... It's over..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.dst: V-você!! Eu- ah, não... Eu... Acabou..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.src: Hey, hey, calm down! I'm here to actually help you... in a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.dst: Ei, ei, calma! Vim te ajudar de verdade... de certa forma.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.speaker: Efena
